# system.registerLayout

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.8</span></div>

Register a Lua Layout.

```lua
system.registerLayout(params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `params` | table | yes | see the fields below |

Fields of `params`:

- `key` (string): unique key, with 7 chars max
- `widgets` (table of rect, optional): layout widgets slots
- `trims` (table of rect, optional): layout trims slots
- `pots` (table of rect, optional): layout pots slots


## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function init()
    system.registerLayout({key="foo", widgets={
      {x=10, y=10, w=100, h=100},
      {x=120, y=120, w=100, h=100}}
    })
end

return {init=init}
```
